en: Visualization style. Smooth (default): spectrum-driven brightness with a slowly drifting palette. Ambient: colour cycling only, no brightness modulation. Flashing: brightness pulse on every beat, stronger on downbeats. Energetic: large brightness swings on hits plus fast palette rotation.
